_comment: D15n mode d15a_safe_nofla: d15a_safe with ONLY "train_rwkv7_wkv": "fla" removed, so training steps run rwkv7_wkv chunked_lean (no fla-core install at setup; D10w job-hgwsq = 40.14 trained chunked_lean vs D1-fla 28.46 = -6.7 vs D1: fla training suspected harmful). Steps ~1.46x slower, so fewer steps fit in the same 190-min clock; cosine horizon = the clock-projected final step at runtime; caps unchanged. d15a_safe's comment follows. Mode d15a_safe (D15a): job_params_d15_v3w_bschema300k.json with only the cell config (m2_first_cell_rwkv7_d15a_safe.json = d15 cell + anti-collapse safe keys), mode, job/key/label/command changed; clock, caps, data and screen are d15's. d15's comment follows. D15 mode d15_v3w_bschema300k (first big-data cell): d3_v3w_fast params with the cell config (m2_first_cell_rwkv7_d15_v3w_bschema300k.json: + train_rwkv7_wkv fla, train_max_k 255 / row_options 160, B's bschema-draw300k-v1 300k set, 377-min train clock), train_dir m2/build/bschema-draw300k-v1 (pinned by jobs/m2_first_cell/data_d15_bschema300k.sha256), stage screen (JOB_SPEC 'stage screen'; screen_readout v3w, screen_reference preset d1_v3w = job-39gnn art-zskmx v3w child 38.67, screen_parent preset stock_v3w = job-fgu2c art-ivu28 31.07, both shipped via context.data) and caps re-sized to the 900-min job ceiling. Schedule: setup 25 + guard 5 + heldout 10 + parent_g12 85 + parent_index 65 + cell 532 + screen 165 + report 5 + reserve 7 = 899 = max_duration. Cell 532 = 377 train + 155 overhead (D3's 40 incl. 10 tokenize for 24k + 115 more tokenize for 300k at 10 min / 24k). Screen 165: the screen rebuilds all 300k training items for the lineage check (train.m2_gates cell_items), so screen_fixed_minutes = D1's 15 + 115 = 130, + 25.97 D1 proxy child scoring = 156 <= 0.95 x 165. Parent = pinned stock_v3w preset (in-job parent arm phase unchanged). Worst case = (60 + 2 x 899) x 0.0495 = $91.97 (hard cap 5, as D11's 899-min clock). d3_v3w_fast's comment follows. DRAFT, NOT SUBMITTED. Mode d3_v3w_fast: job_params_d3_v2f_fast.json with only the cell config changed (m2_first_cell_rwkv7_d3_v3w_fast.json = d3_v2f_fast with template jrt-rwkv-g1-v3w; parent arm in-job via G1V3Backend mode words). Caps, data, schedule and worst case are d3_v2f_fast's ($66.03). d3_v2f_fast's comment follows. DRAFT, NOT SUBMITTED. Mode d3_v2f_fast: job_params_d3_v2f_gold.json with only the cell config changed (m2_first_cell_rwkv7_d3_v2f_fast.json = d3_v2f_gold + the d1_fast flags row_plan min_cost, cont_plan single, compile_blocks; job-2amiy 1.40x step). Caps, data, schedule and worst case are d3_v2f_gold's ($66.03). d3_v2f_gold's comment follows. d3_v2f_gold: d3_r1_gold with template jrt-rwkv-g1-v2f (v2 + dict-instruction fix). d3_r1_gold: D3 on the R1 readout format (cell m2_first_cell_rwkv7_d3_v2f_gold.json). Changes vs job_params.json: cell config (template/layout = C1 format v2), the parent arm is scored in-job in the same format (parent_arm_seed arm_sha256 null, its three context.data entries dropped: the v1 seed's unit spec no longer matches), submit command/key/label. Caps and max_duration unchanged (they already priced parent_g12 + parent_index). DRAFT, NOT SUBMITTED. First trained m2 cell (jobs/m2_first_cell/JOB_SPEC.md). Phase order: setup, guard, heldout, parent_g12, parent_index (live rate guard measures the box BEFORE training; jobs.m2_first_cell.reprice re-prices the child evals), cell, evals, report. Caps sized so a box up to 25 % slower than job-tkfaj (prefill and per-call latency) completes every scoring phase (projection <= 95 % of the cap); slower boxes stop before training. Worst case = (build_timeout + attempts x max_duration) x batch rate with attempts = 1 + max(max_restarts, assumed_restart_floor) (jobs/common/costs.py) = (60 + 2 x 637) x 0.0495 = $66.03. build_timeout 60 per the launch lint (L-09: image publish timeouts). Expected minutes: scoring phases at the job-tkfaj probe rates (TOK_S 3,757 at 2,048 tokens, CALL_S 0.117); training at the job-tvuat ADOPT step time (median 8.25 s, ckpt_rows_lean).
